integrity: Embedded finite certificate and standard-library checker recreate the mathematical assertions; published overlap searches cannot exclude all unindexed sources.
scientific_limitations: Sixteen-vertex four-cube only; faults restricted to one parity class of four parallel edges. Integral homotopy and simple-homotopy results are supported by exhaustive standalone finite certificates. No larger-cube or equivariant classification is claimed.
title: Saturation of independent-set homotopy under parity-class edge faults in the four-cube
